main_text.p: p[?]us, Hebræos roborare in fide & pietate, à seductione, lapsu & mundi inquinamentis præstare immunes. iii. Eadem motiva, non tardaturum Dominum, appropinquare illius adventum, nec aliter quàm pro ipsorum salute prorogari. Hebr. x. 25.37. 2.Pet. iii. 9.10.11.12.13. Posterius vero membrum Petrinæ hortationis, scil. constanter novissimam illam diem expectent, nec morari Deum sed ipsorum & electorum omnium bono patientia nonnihil uti arbitrentur, exponit idem author Epist. ad Hebræos Cap. x. v. 36. 37. & Cap. vi. 12. &c. Utrobique i. eadem commonefactio ad εὐδοκίαν[?], sive ὑπομονὴν[?], sive μακροθυμίαν[?], & quidem circa adventum Domini non ita protrahendum. ii. Idem etiam scopus, Hebræos erigere spe retributionis & beati illius adventus, eorumque animos contra diffidentiam defectionemque præmunire. Quæ si ita habeant, nostra stabit assertio.

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; "41" is the ornamented numeral at top right and may be misread. "p[?]us" at the top: the first letter is obscured by a mark, probably "pius", continuing from the previous page. Greek words are doubtful in their exact accents and forms and are marked [?]. "videntur" is marked [?] because the final letters are unclear. The "1." of "Utrobique i." and "ii." are printed as roman numerals and are kept as printed. No marginal notes are visible.
